headline: Iran Threat Forces Secret Trump Air Force One Evacuation
deck: A post-summit flight from Turkey saw President Trump secretly transferred from his plane, transforming Air Force One into a decoy following an Iran-related security alert.
body: President Trump was secretly evacuated from Air Force One due to a security threat related to Iran, forcing an elaborate ruse after a summit in Turkey and raising immediate concerns about presidential safety.

Following the evacuation, Air Force One became a flying decoy, designed to mislead any potential adversaries. Trump instead used a different aircraft to depart Turkey, a maneuver described by NBC4 Washington and Reuters as an "elaborate ruse."
President Trump himself confirmed that a security threat spurred the secret plane swap. He stated his original plane faced "greater risk" in the flight change, according to Reuters.
Multiple outlets, including NBC News and Reuters, reported the security threat was specifically related to Iran. The White House has not publicly commented on the specifics of this threat.

The incident unfolded after a summit in Turkey, where Trump had been meeting with other world leaders. This timing placed the President in a region already marked by significant geopolitical tensions.

The White House Correspondents Association (WHCA) has since pressed the White House for safeguards regarding the press pool. CNN reported these concerns arose directly from the incident, highlighting the risks faced by journalists covering presidential travel.

The secret evacuation and subsequent decoy operation have amplified concerns about the safety of both the President and the accompanying press pool. This event underscores the inherent dangers of presidential travel abroad.

The incident has sparked a debate about the necessary balance between robust presidential security and transparency with the public and press. Unanswered questions about the threat's specifics continue to fuel this discussion.
